references.text: God promises to bless Abraham and his descendants, a blessing that is passed on to Isaac after Abraham's death.
God promises to establish His covenant with Isaac, Abraham's son, and ensures that the blessing will continue through him.
Abraham gave everything he owned to Isaac, emphasizing that Isaac was the chosen heir who received the blessing after Abraham's death.
God renews the promises made to Abraham by blessing Isaac directly, in line with the blessing mentioned after Abraham's death.
Beer-Lahai-Roi is mentioned for the first time, the well where Hagar met the angel of the Lord and which later became Isaac's dwelling place.
Isaac was already living at Beer-Lahai-Roi when he met Rebekah, the same place mentioned here after Abraham's death.
The blessing in 25:11 is a concrete fulfillment of the covenant mentioned in Psalms.
The blessing in 25:11 confirms God's oath to Isaac mentioned in Chronicles.
